source.title: Junior School Curriculum Design: Creative Arts and Sports, Grade 8 (KICD, First published 2023, Revised 2024, ISBN 978-9914-43-983-0)
source.notes: WebFetch could not extract text from this PDF directly ('unable to extract text'), but reported the file saved locally; the Read tool then parsed the full 71-page document natively and verbatim, including all strand/sub-strand/SLO/KIQ tables. Cover page reads 'KENYA INSTITUTE OF CURRICULUM DEVELOPMENT ... JUNIOR SCHOOL CURRICULUM DESIGN CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS GRADE 8', ISBN 978-9914-43-983-0. Independently confirmed against KICD's own Google Drive index (file ID 1ji89ZIdF9ZA5d6rkchqJJYa2G5ZQO5zP on the Grade 8 designs page), whose /preview page shows the exact official filename 'Creative Arts & Sports Grade 8 - Revised.pdf' -- this confirms, same as Grade 9, that Sports is merged into one design with Creative Arts at Grade 8 too (the KICD index page's short label just says 'Creative Arts' but the actual PDF title is 'Creative Arts and Sports'). All strand/sub-strand headings, SLOs and KIQs below are transcribed verbatim from the Read output, not summarized. Pages are watermarked 'DRAFT' -- same pattern as other official KICD Grade 8/9 PDFs circulating publicly, not a sign of an unofficial document. IMPORTANT for later build phases: like Grade 9, this subject is unusually performance/practical-heavy (music performance, sports skills, painting, fabric decoration, basketry, folk dance). Only a minority of sub-strands are purely knowledge/theory-testable in a traditional quiz format. Structural note: strand 2's sub-strand '2.3' is labelled 'Athletics and Montage' in the SUMMARY OF STRAND AND SUB STRANDS table but the detailed body table heading for the same sub-strand reads 'Middle Distance Races and Montage' -- the fuller, more specific body heading is used here as canonical (same resolution approach used for the Grade 9 CAS numbering quirk). Strand 2 also contains an OPTIONAL block (2.12.1 Swimming vs 2.12.2 Kenyan Indigenous Games) where the design instructs the learner to cover only ONE of the two -- both are recorded here since either could be the one a given school selects, matching the Grade 9 CAS pattern exactly (2.11.1/2.11.2 there). Content differs substantially from Grade 9's version of this subject (different sports: Middle Distance Races/Netball/Volleyball vs Grade 9's Triple Jump/Rugby/Basketball; different crafts: Fabric Decoration/Basketry vs Grade 9's Pottery/Weaving/Photography), confirming Grade 8 is not a re-run of Grade 9 content.

strands.name: Foundations of Creative Arts and Sports

subStrands.name: Roles of Creative Arts and Sports
subSubStrands: Roles of Creative Arts and Sports
specificLearningOutcomes: Describe the roles of Creative Arts and Sports in society
Make a storyboard highlighting the roles of Creative Arts and Sports in society
Appreciate the role played by Creative Arts and Sports in society
keyInquiryQuestions: What is the importance of Creative Arts and Sports in society?
subStrands.notes: Knowledge-testable (describing social/economic roles) is a good quiz fit; the storyboard-making component (collecting/cutting pictures, painting a background, pasting) is a practical/artistic task.

subStrands.name: Components of Creative Arts and Sports
subSubStrands: Elements of a Verse: character, theme, setting
Endurance and agility components of physical fitness
Pitch: Bass staff, ledger lines, G major, piano keyboard, accidentals, middle C
Rhythm: semibreve, minim, crotchet, a pair of quavers
specificLearningOutcomes: Describe elements of Verse
Perform activities that enhance endurance and agility in physical fitness
Write note values on the bass staff
Name pitches on the bass staff
Group music notes in 3/4 time
Construct the scale of G major on a staff
Appreciate the basic elements of Creative Arts and Sports
keyInquiryQuestions: What are the components of Creative Arts and Sports?
subStrands.notes: Mixed: describing verse elements, writing/naming bass-staff pitches, grouping notes, and constructing the G major scale are knowledge-testable; performing fitness activities is a physical-performance outcome this app cannot grade directly.

strands.name: Creating and Performing in Creative Arts and Sports

subStrands.name: Drawing and Painting
specificLearningOutcomes: Discuss dominance in a picture
Classify complementary colours on a colour wheel
Illustrate a colour gradation strip for colour contrast
Paint a still life composition to express dominance
Appreciate own and others' pictures
keyInquiryQuestions: What are complimentary colours?
How is dominance created using in a picture?
subStrands.notes: Largely practical/artistic performance (painting a still life composition, colour wheel construction) -- this app cannot grade the physical execution, only underlying knowledge (colour theory, classification, dominance concepts).

subStrands.name: Rhythm
specificLearningOutcomes: Describe 3/4 time in music
Compose a four-bar rhythmic pattern in 3/4 time
Perform four-bar rhythmic patterns in 3/4 time
Appreciate creating rhythms in 3/4 time
keyInquiryQuestions: How does one acquire the skill of composing rhythm in music?
What is the role of rhythm in day to day life?
subStrands.notes: Substantially knowledge-testable (describing 3/4 time, notation) though composing/performing rhythmic patterns leans practical.

subStrands.name: Middle Distance Races and Montage
subSubStrands: Montage (subject, posture, centre of interest, finishing)
specificLearningOutcomes: Describe middle distance races in athletics
Perform middle distance races for skill acquisition
Discuss characteristics of a montage composition
Create a montage composition inspired by athletes running
Acknowledge own and others' effort in middle distance running and montage for enjoyment
keyInquiryQuestions: How do running techniques affect performance in middle distance races?
What is the difference between montage and photomontage?
subStrands.notes: This is the sub-strand the SUMMARY OF STRAND AND SUB STRANDS table labels '2.3 Athletics and Montage' (12 lessons); the detailed body table heading instead reads 'Middle Distance Races and Montage' -- treated here as the canonical name since it is the more specific/detailed heading, per the source-document quirk noted at the top of this file. Combines physical/athletic performance (middle distance running: 800m, 1500m) with artistic craft performance (montage-making from cut photographs) -- both need a non-traditional quiz approach; only the descriptive/characteristic-discussion outcomes are directly knowledge-testable.

subStrands.name: Melody
subSubStrands: Question and answer phrases in a melody
4-bar melodies in G Major and 3/4 time
Extending a melody using exact repetition, and varied repetition
specificLearningOutcomes: Describe methods of creating a melody
Compose a 2-bar answering phrase to a given 2-bar opening phrase
Compose a 4-bar melody in G Major
Perform simple pieces of music in G Major
Value the use of melody in Creative Arts and Sports
keyInquiryQuestions: How can a melody be extended to make it interesting?
subStrands.notes: Mixed: describing melody-extension methods is knowledge-testable; composing, notating, and performing melodies are practical/performance skills this app cannot grade directly.

subStrands.name: Netball
specificLearningOutcomes: Describe the execution of different passes in Netball
Perform passes in Netball for skill acquisition
Execute dodging and marking in Netball for skill development
Perform footwork skills in a Netball game situation
Appreciate teamwork in application of netball skills for fun and enjoyment
keyInquiryQuestions: What is the importance of dodging and marking skill in a game of Netball?
What footwork options does a player have after landing with a ball in a Netball game?
subStrands.notes: Almost entirely physical/practical (executing passes, footwork, dodging/marking) -- needs a non-traditional quiz approach; only 'describing execution of passes' (naming/identifying pass types) is directly knowledge-testable.

subStrands.name: Fabric Decoration
specificLearningOutcomes: Identify fabrics decorated for familiarity
Tie and dye a fabric using marbling
Decorate a fabric using pleating technique
Print fabric using a stencil
Acknowledge tie and dye, and stencil printing as fabric decorating techniques
keyInquiryQuestions: Why do we finish a decorated fabric?
subStrands.notes: Predominantly hands-on craft production (marbling, pleating, stencil printing, sewing a tote bag) -- needs a non-traditional quiz approach; identifying decorated fabrics is knowledge-testable.

subStrands.name: Descant Recorder
subSubStrands: Techniques of playing a descant recorder: fingering, pinching, slurring, embouchure, tonguing, blowing
Performance directions: repeat (da capo al fine, dal segno al fine)
specificLearningOutcomes: Explain techniques of playing a descant recorder
Interpret performance directions on given pieces of music
Perform simple melodies in G Major on a descant recorder
Value playing music on the descant recorder or any other Western solo instrument
keyInquiryQuestions: What is the importance of applying technique when playing a descant recorder?
subStrands.notes: Predominantly instrumental performance (playing the recorder, applying technique) -- needs a non-traditional quiz approach; explaining techniques and interpreting performance-direction terminology (da capo al fine, dal segno al fine) are knowledge-testable.

subStrands.name: Verse
specificLearningOutcomes: Describe language use in verse
Compose a verse to address an issue in society
Perform a verse before an audience
Acknowledge the use of verse as a means of communication
keyInquiryQuestions: How can verse performance be made interesting and memorable?
Why is it important to decorate props to be used for performance?
subStrands.notes: Mixed: describing language use in verse (imagery, sound devices, diction, line and stanza) is knowledge-testable; composing and performing a verse before an audience are practical/performance tasks this app cannot grade directly.

subStrands.name: Volleyball
specificLearningOutcomes: Identify the overarm serve in Volleyball game
Serve the ball using overarm serve over a net
Perform the volleying skill in Volleyball
Appraise others' efforts when applying serving and volleying skills in Volleyball
keyInquiryQuestions: How does the volley pass make the Volleyball game interesting?
subStrands.notes: Almost entirely physical/practical (executing overarm serve and volleying) -- needs a non-traditional quiz approach; identifying the overarm serve and appraising performance are knowledge/reasoning-testable.

subStrands.name: Kenyan Folk Dance
subSubStrands: Classification of folk dances: community, gender and age of participants, occasion
specificLearningOutcomes: Classify folk dances from Kenyan communities
Perform a folk dance from a Kenyan community
Appreciate different cultures through performing folk dances from diverse Kenyan communities
keyInquiryQuestions: How do folk dances represent Kenyan culture?
What makes a good folk dance performance?
subStrands.notes: Mixed: classifying folk dances by community/gender/age/occasion is knowledge-testable; performing a folk dance is a practical/performance task this app cannot grade directly.

subStrands.name: Indigenous Kenyan Craft (Basketry)
subSubStrands: Materials - sisal, banana fibre, raffia, recyclable synthetic fabric among others
specificLearningOutcomes: Identify basketry items made using coil techniques
Make a basketry item using the coil method
Appreciate basketry as an indigenous craft in Kenya
keyInquiryQuestions: How does basket making contribute to the economic well-being of communities?
subStrands.notes: Predominantly hands-on craft production (coil-method weaving of a mat/tray) -- needs a non-traditional quiz approach; identifying basketry items and discussing economic contribution is knowledge-testable.

subStrands.name: Swimming (Optional)
specificLearningOutcomes: Explain the inverted breaststroke and water treading technique in swimming
Perform water treading skill in swimming
Perform the inverted breaststroke technique in swimming for skill acquisition
Combine the skills of water treading and inverted breaststroke for skill mastery
Acknowledge own and others' efforts while performing water treading and inverted breaststroke skills in swimming
keyInquiryQuestions: How is inverted breaststroke used in life saving?
Why is water treading skill important?
subStrands.notes: OPTIONAL sub-strand: the design's 'OPTIONAL SUB STRANDS' section instructs the learner to cover at least ONE of Swimming OR Kenyan Indigenous Games, not necessarily both. Almost entirely physical/practical performance requiring pool access -- needs a non-traditional quiz approach; explaining technique/body position is knowledge-testable.

subStrands.name: Kenyan Indigenous Games (Optional)
specificLearningOutcomes: Identify types of indigenous tagging games played in Kenya
Perform different indigenous tagging games for skill acquisition
Perform indigenous tagging games using musical rhythm for coordination
Appreciate the role played by indigenous tagging games for enjoyment
keyInquiryQuestions: How do indigenous tagging skills enhance physical fitness?
Why is tagging considered an indigenous game?
subStrands.notes: OPTIONAL sub-strand: the learner covers at least ONE of this (Kenyan Indigenous Games -- Tagging) OR Swimming, not necessarily both. Unlike Grade 9 (which offered board games under this option), Grade 8's indigenous-games option is specifically Tagging. Mixed: identifying tagging game types is knowledge-testable; performing the games is a practical/physical skill.

strands.name: Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports

subStrands.name: Analysis of Creative Arts and Sports
subSubStrands: Artwork: drawing, painting and montage pictures, decorated fabric, basketry items
specificLearningOutcomes: Showcase artwork for appreciation
Analyse a verse performance
Examine the spirit of sportsmanship in sporting activities
Analyse a folk dance from a Kenyan community
Appreciate the role of analysis in adding value to Creative Arts and Sports
keyInquiryQuestions: Why is analysis an important skill in Creative Arts and Sports?
subStrands.notes: The most quiz-friendly sub-strand in this subject: analysing a verse performance, examining sportsmanship, and analysing a folk dance are reasoning/critique skills rather than physical or artistic execution, though they presuppose the learner has been exposed to the performances/artworks being analysed. The 'showcase artwork for appreciation' outcome is a practical/display task.
